result.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('base',(SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM network_vpc_base_connectivity b WHERE vpc_id='vpc_1f6fbd7f85cd4baba0b0382770aa480e'),'children',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',resource_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'reason',reason,'next',next_attempt_at)) FROM (SELECT operation_id AS resource_id,kind,state,reason,next_attempt_at FROM network_operations WHERE vpc_id='vpc_1f6fbd7f85cd4baba0b0382770aa480e') o));
